classification_vocabulary.ACTIVE_FLIGHT_INCONSISTENCY: reached by the active hall_icp_neutralizer production chain (programme / design synthesis F1-F9, golden active reference case, mass / power / Xe budgets, RVM, bid package) and carries or assumes a hollow cathode / LaB6 / C1 term that the cathodeless flight architecture does not have
classification_vocabulary.GROUND_REFERENCE: C1 / cathode content explicitly scoped to the ground-only laboratory reference (H-1 I_d,max,H1,Ar characterization; C1-vs-ICP bench control) and kept out of the flight budgets
classification_vocabulary.HISTORICAL_REGRESSION: legacy or superseded paths (pre-A9 cards and archengine LaB6 neutralizer, A5-era Hall-only / RF+Hall / ECR+Hall comparison lanes, superseded budget versions, golden historical cases, convergence / performance workloads, tests) that no active hall_icp_neutralizer chain consumes

severity_vocabulary_for_active_inconsist.NUMERIC: a committed flight number (budget line / roll-up) contains a cathode share
severity_vocabulary_for_active_inconsist.LATENT: an active-chain code path instantiates or carries a cathode term, but no currently reported flight number depends on it
severity_vocabulary_for_active_inconsist.LABEL: requirement / record text in an active document still names a flight cathode element; no number

summary.headline: No active hall_icp_neutralizer code path instantiates LaB6Cathode. The LaB6Cathode class is reached only from the legacy card closure (system.py plasma_physics branch) and the archengine lab6_xe neutralizer, both HISTORICAL_REGRESSION. observations.text: config/model_set/physics_model_set_v1.json hashes every abep_sim module (archengine, plasma_devices, system, thruster, life, thermal_life, uq6, mission5, ...) with no active / historical role. The A9.24 bid freeze records a model-set hash and A9.24 item 7 asks to migrate 'the whole active Python stack' (system closure, architecture engine, sweep, ...). Nothing machine-readable marks the LaB6 / card paths HR-01..HR-08 as historical, so the Rust migration could port them as active paths. Recommendation for the owner: decide a retirement / HISTORICAL label for these paths before migration ordering, per A9.24 item 13 ('Do NOT silently fix it inside the Rust migration').

archengine's A9.22 G4 flight guard excludes only lab6_xe. The air-fed plasma-bridge cathode neutralizers mw_air and rf_cathode remain flight-eligible in require_flight_eligible / run_all(flight=True); golden.py:392 states rf_cathode does not represent the A9 ICP. No active caller uses flight=True, so no number is affected.

golden_v2 case 'accelerators' (role CANONICAL) evaluates ecr+grids+lab6_xe and ecr+hall+lab6_xe; ecr_hall.P_neut_W = 34.554 W is the LaB6 neutralizer power. It is not labelled HISTORICAL_NON_FLIGHT_REGRESSION; removing the LaB6 neutralizer would change only that key.

Stale A9.2 status 'C1 conventional reference = CONTROL_FALLBACK' is carried verbatim (pinned) in F7/F8, F9, the H-1 freeze candidate and P3 v2. F7/F8 (a9_19_20_supersessions), F9 and H-1 carry the A9.20 supersession elsewhere in the record; P3 v2 does not (part of AFI-03).
